scope: Acceptance metadata snapshot only, not implementation/test execution proof

focusedRule: Criteria1-10 are aggregate gates; no task-title behavior inference.

criteria.title: Record the user intent and establish acceptance coverage
criteria.body: Record the full user intent and cover it with exhaustive grouped acceptance criteria.
criteria.verification: Read the intent file and compare the grouped criteria against the brief.

No JS-engine delegation, unimplemented supported APIs, successful no-op placeholders, or silently narrowed scope. Preserve attribution and meet AGENTS.md safety and code-quality rules.
criteria.verification: Verify the requirement against task evidence.

criteria.title: Map every upstream contract, module and suite

criteria.title: Port assertions and run baseline/differential suites
criteria.body: Faithfully migrate upstream assertions and execute original baselines plus Rust unit, integration, differential, and end-to-end tests. Compare complete terminal state, attributes, events/replies, API operations, lifecycle and addon behavior on identical deterministic and reproducibly seeded randomized/chunked input. Preserve upstream fixtures and counterexamples. Record exact discovered/mapped/executed/passed/failed/skipped/unrun suite counts; no weakened assertions or undisclosed exclusions.
criteria.verification: Verify the requirement against task evidence.

criteria.title: Run native and browser end-to-end tests
criteria.body: Execute end-to-end verification through the actual Rust native example and Rust-backed browser build, with applicable Chromium/Firefox/WebKit coverage of rendering, input, mouse, selection, clipboard, accessibility, resizing, disposal, and addons. Provide native Windows, Linux, and macOS build/runtime-test evidence; CI configuration and cross-compilation must not be presented as successful runtime execution.

criteria.title: Pass build, lint, safety and independent review gates

criteria.title: Document setup and ship working native/browser demos

criteria.title: Measure equivalent speed and distributed artifact size
